items.claim: poseFrameInverseOf / pathThroughPoseFrame throw on a null or undefined pose
stepLine with a zero or non-finite step answers a NaN direction
items.note: I made the strict call: `stepLine` now throws a `RangeError` for such a step. It is recorded in `docs/unruled.md`, and the `SnapConstrain` doc in core says so.

items.claim: tagTypedArrays and typedArrayReplacer disagree on class instances
items.note: The finding was partly wrong. A plain class instance already tags as `[object Object]`, so `isPlain` was true for it and it was handled. The same disagreement was real for an object with `toJSON` and for an instance with its own `Symbol.toStringTag`. `tagTypedArrays` now copies an object the way `JSON.stringify` writes it, for both cases.

items.claim: trackRun.nearest clamps the whole shape's nearest point into the run
Quadrant snap points are centered on the control-point box
polygonIntersectsPath with `filled: false` counts an open subpath's closing chord
rotatePathAbout writes far-out coords into float32 with no origin
ringSignedArea loses its sign far from the origin
items.note: `booleans/adapter.ts` has a private copy with the same mistake. It is outside this area and I had no failing test for it, so I left it alone.

items.claim: shiftTrack carries a closed shape past its seam at the end's ratio
The paths guide says `dist` and `tolerance` where the code has `distance` and `flattenTolerance`
ellipseShape with `start: 0, end: 360` is zero-length or not quite closed
